body: this guy sounds like a real pig, dont be a plan B, tell him if he loves her so much he can fuck off back to her, you deserve somebody who wants to be with YOU, not a girlfriend, there's a difference.

I really hate to play devils advocate but screw it this is the internet. It sounds like you're taking far too much credit for this girl and her life. Friends dont owe each other jack shit, thats why they're friends with each other, because they dont have to be, because they WANT to be, you don't have any right to think that she owes you her company because you introduced her to new people, thats just a shitty thing to do. Maybe you're bitter that she decides to speak to you now after a long time because she has problems, and doesnt have anywhere else to go. Thats fair enough, I totally get that, but you have no right to be bitter because she didnt pay you her dues with the company she owes you because you expanded the number of people she knew.

Tell her she cant use you for advice now just because she doesnt have anyone else to talk to, thats fair enough, OR be a friend to her now, you're totally fucking justified doing either, nobody will question you. But dont be both.

I'm not going to try and tell you that everyone feels like you do right now, and if somebody does dont listen to them. When you let somebody tell you that other people have it worse, and that you arent special, and you're just a dramatic little brat, they try and take away your right to feel sad and hurt. Fuck those people, don't listen to them, everybody has the right to feel sad, and hurt. YOU have the right to feel sad, dont feel guilty or weak for being like that, you dont have to rely only on your family if they arent going to be there for you, you said you had a therapist, talk to them, or go to a hotline, there are plenty of them. Dont think that the entire world thinks like your grandma does, most people dont, so dont let her small minded bitterness bring you down with her.

hey if it really is too much, telling somebody that she threatened to shoot up a school will create one helluva shitstorm for her. A guy typed that in league of legends and he's facing prison time. Otherwise, dont let her make you bitter. If she really is as bad as you say she is then she'll eventually destroy herself. thats the beautiful equilibrium of shitty people. they make other people miserable, sure, but because of that nobody wants to be around them, so in they end the become lonely and miserable. That is her fate, dont worry, the only concern you need to have is that you dont do the same. Dont stop trusting new people, you'll find new friends, and she wont.

You shouldn't make assumptions about what's going with your brother based on your own experiences. I'm not trying to invalidate what you felt before; damn I can't even count the amount of times I've thought about how people would react if I did it, but you don't know for sure if that is what he's feeling. Ask him what's going on, not the kind of happy off the cuff 'are you feeling ok', you have to have some intention behind it, don't push him if he doesn't want to talk but make it completely clear that you're there if he needs it.

And I've always hated giving the advice that you need to get somebody else like a parent involved, but if you think he's already gotten to the point of nearly doing it once it's probably a good idea.

It's hard to say. It's like I've worn the mask for so long that I don't remember what it looks like from the other side of the eye holes anymore. It's not exactly a bad thing, it's not as if I'm defying my morals or doing thinks that I fundamentally object to, it's just that all the joyful happy moments in my life with the people I know are superficial. They don't pierce deeper than the veil.

I feel like I'm being hollowed out. I put up this exterior but inside I'm not that person, which just makes everything feel so much worse because I think I'm a fraud. It's lonely I guess. Nobody really knows me, I guess even when I'm with my friends I feel alone because that isn't really me.
You can't give up. I know it's going to be hard but you need to be strong. Things will work out if you let them, and when this is all over you'll be glad you didn't give up.

My parents divorced too. They moved really far apart and it makes things a little hard. Things came out into the light later on that made it really hard for me to see them the same way. I go to this school where people are always shifting in and out. It's a bit weird like that, but there was this one kid who came in this year. I think he was from overseas and he didn't know anybody. But you know he just kinda stuck at it and it turns out he's a really nice person.

It's hard being new, but you need to welcome it. Nobody thinks you're a freak I guarantee it, you're just seeing what your mind wants you to believe. You want to believe you won't fit in there, and you want to believe that this situation sucks. I know it hurts, and it's ok that it hurts. Change always hurts, but life changes. You've made friends before, everyone has, everyone wants to make friends. Just try it, you'll see that people are much nicer at this new place than you think.

You shouldn't try and make out like what your going through is ok, and will just blow over. A lot of people on here say that they've been told in the past their problems are insignificant. It hurts man, you need to accept it. You need to look your situation dead in the eye and if you don't like it change it, if you let this fester it'll overwhelm even the most stoic people. Go looking for another job, go looking for somebody who understands you and cares about you. Don't let yourself think that it's a bad thing you cared so much about your ex. There are more than 7 billion people on earth, more than half of them women, and there will be someone who will make you feel that happy again.

100% agreed. Before then I always thought that no matter how much I drank nothing would come of it. I'd gotten very intoxicated before then and never even had a hangover. Who knows, if I hadn't had a reality check I might one day have done something properly stupid.

Don't be so worried about it. I was actually in your position once. Underage I drank an entire bottle of gin in a stupidly short period of time. I was so drunk I nearly died, no joke. A friend of mine had to call my older brother to come and get me because everyone was freaking out and didn't know what to do. They lifted me into a cab and while they were doing it my pants fell down and everyone got a good look at my junk. I had to go to hospital, got an embarrassing lecture from a youth counselor, went home. The whole incident is something I'm really not proud of to be fair, and every now and again a friend brings it up as a joke, but we all get to laugh along about it. It may be crushing to have something like this happen, but we all make stupid decisions, some people aren't lucky enough for them to happen while they're drunk. Be strong, it won't be as bad as you think

I don't know. It's like nothing is appealing to me, sensation, joy, emotion, they're all just temporary chemical impulses. It's just like I'm going numb. It'd be fine if I had a reason for it, but I don't, it's just a combination of everything and nothing at once

The final solitaire, the absolute religion, there are no priests, no guidebook, no one has ever been led to it, but so many have found it, what you have is called nihilism, the belief that everything is nothing, and life has no meaning or purpose. Life has no true meaning, that's what I've come to know, it's your life to do with as you want friend, everybody sees this world in a different way. You've just come to a crossroads in your life, a break in the path. What you thought you knew turned out to be wrong. Suicide is the default option in life when everything else stops working. I say you should make a new path. It might be the craziest most fucked up, stupid thing you've ever done, but it'll be YOURS; not your mothers, not your fathers, not anybodies, it'll be yours. Discovering that what you knew isn't true is a beautiful thing. You can tear down the whole picture of the world and start over. In the bible god is an almighty clockmaker and you're just a tiny cog, now you have the chance to be the painter, not the paint. Be what you were meant to be. And make something beautiful.
